name: HTML5
description: Standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.
howToUse: Use semantic elements (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <article>, <footer>) for SEO and accessibility. Ensure all forms have labels and ARIA attributes for clean personal tools and dashboards.

name: CSS3
description: Style sheet language used for describing the presentation of a document written in HTML.
howToUse: Leverage CSS custom properties (variables) for theme tokens, Flexbox for 1D navigation layouts, and CSS Grid for 2D responsive dashboards. Use clamp() for fluid typography.

name: JavaScript (ES6+)
description: Lightweight, interpreted programming language with first-class functions for web apps.
howToUse: Build modular code using ES modules (import/export), async/await for network requests, localStorage for lightweight client-side persistence, and custom events for component communication.

name: React
description: The library for web and native user interfaces based on reusable components and declarative state.
howToUse: Use when creating multi-view single page applications with complex state. Pair with Vite for rapid project scaffolding and use custom hooks (e.g. useLocalStorage, useFetch) to separate UI from logic.

name: Python
description: Versatile, high-level programming language ideal for scripting, backend APIs, data handling, and AI automation.
howToUse: Use FastAPI or Flask for lightweight REST APIs, BeautifulSoup/Playwright for web scrapers, and Pydantic for strict schema validation. Excellent for automation scripts and data wrangling.

name: Node.js
description: Open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment executing code outside a web browser.
howToUse: Use Express or Hono for API backends, npm scripts for build pipelines, and Node built-in fs/path modules for custom CLI utilities and file processors.

name: Bootstrap 5
description: Powerful, extensible, and feature-packed frontend toolkit with responsive grid, prebuilt components, and utility classes.
howToUse: Ideal for fast prototyping and internal personal tools. Use the container-fluid + row + col system for responsive layouts, modals for overlays, and customize via CSS variables without bloating your build.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework packed with classes that can be composed to build any custom design.
howToUse: Best for tailor-made, highly polished modern web apps. Use arbitrary variants, grid layouts, and color palettes. Combine with @apply or reusable component wrappers for scalable UI code.

name: Express.js
description: Minimal, unopinionated Node.js web application framework for building REST APIs, backend services, and dynamic web apps.
howToUse: Use on top of Node.js to organize HTTP routes, attach composable middleware (express.json, CORS, authentication, rate limiting), serve web pages or JSON APIs, and centralize error handling across full-stack applications.

name: MySQL
description: World's most popular open-source relational database management system (RDBMS) for structured relational data.
howToUse: Use when data requires strict relational schemas, ACID compliance, and complex join queries. Pair with Prisma or Knex in Node.js, or SQLAlchemy in Python for type-safe ORM migrations.

name: Supabase
description: Open-source Firebase alternative providing a dedicated PostgreSQL database, Auth, Storage, and Realtime APIs.
howToUse: The go-to choice for solo projects: get instant auth (OAuth, Magic Link), Postgres with Row-Level Security (RLS), auto-generated REST/GraphQL endpoints, and bucket file storage in minutes.

name: Superpowers
description: Agentic skills and composable capability extensions enabling LLMs to interact with tools, browsers, and environments.
howToUse: Equip AI agents with custom reasoning skills, automated task workflows, and repeatable tool patterns. Store specialized prompts and tool schemas in project agent configs.

name: Ponytail
description: Developer productivity skill and workflow automation tool for streamlining project execution and code tasks.
howToUse: Use as a companion workflow booster to manage repetitive tasks, command pipelines, and environment setups across personal codebases.

name: Wayfinder
description: Pathfinding and architectural navigation skill for tracing relationships, project hierarchies, and dependency graphs.
howToUse: Employ when jumping into new repositories or multi-module projects to map dependencies, trace entry points, and identify circular links quickly.

name: Taste
description: Design critique, aesthetic curation, and UI evaluation skill for ensuring high visual polish in software.
howToUse: Run aesthetic audits on UI layouts before launch. Check color harmony, typography hierarchy, whitespace balance, and micro-interactions for a WOW impression.

name: Claude Skills
description: Structured tool-use definitions, prompt templates, and system instructions tailored for Claude & agentic workflows.
howToUse: Implement structured JSON tool definitions (name, description, input_schema) to give LLMs deterministic API-calling capabilities, file editing abilities, and external data lookup.

name: Graphify
description: Converts codebases and documentation into persistent, navigable knowledge graphs with community clustering, visual HTML topologies, and GraphRAG querying.
howToUse: Run /graphify in root to generate interactive HTML maps (graph.html) and audit reports (GRAPH_REPORT.md). Use graphify query '<question>' or graphify path 'Auth' 'Database' to map dependencies, trace god nodes before refactoring, and export --wiki or --obsidian vaults for project documentation.

name: React Bits
description: Curated collection of lightweight, copy-paste animated React components, text effects, and interactive UI elements.
howToUse: Browse for animated hero titles, magnetic buttons, interactive card hover effects, and background shaders to make client-side React apps feel responsive, dynamic, and visually stunning.

name: Figma
description: Collaborative cloud-based interface design, prototyping, and wireframing platform used by product designers.
howToUse: Use for high-fidelity wireframing before writing code. Define design tokens (colors, spacing, typography), auto-layout components, and export SVGs directly for web apps.

name: Untitled UI
description: The ultimate UI kit and design system for Figma, featuring thousands of modern components, charts, and icons.
howToUse: Speed up frontend development by borrowing proven SaaS dashboard layouts, clean data tables, card designs, and button styles. Excellent inspiration for clean, minimalist interfaces.

name: GitHub
description: Cloud-based hosting service for Git repositories with issue tracking, pull requests, and automated CI/CD workflows.
howToUse: Use for repository versioning, GitHub Actions automation, GitHub Pages static hosting, issue management, and collaborative code reviews via Pull Requests.

name: Render
description: Unified cloud platform to build and run web services, backend APIs, cron jobs, and static sites with automatic Git deployments.
howToUse: Use for deploying full-stack backends (Node.js, Python), background workers, and web services. Connect directly to GitHub branches for zero-downtime auto-deploys and configure environment variables via the Render dashboard or render.yaml blueprints.

name: Vercel
description: Frontend cloud platform optimized for React, Next.js, and static web apps with instant edge network deployment and preview URLs.
howToUse: Ideal for deploying React/Vite frontends, serverless API routes, and static sites. Link your GitHub repo to get automatic PR preview deployments, instant rollbacks, and custom domain SSL out of the box.

name: Redis
description: Open-source, in-memory data structure store used as a high-speed cache, session store, rate limiter, and message broker.
howToUse: Use to cache expensive API responses or database queries, store user sessions, and manage API rate limiting or background job queues (e.g., with BullMQ). Set TTLs on cache keys to keep memory fresh.

name: Brevo
description: Transactional email, SMTP relay, and messaging API platform with open-source SDKs for automated notifications and campaigns.
howToUse: Integrate via REST API or SMTP to send transactional emails (OTP verification codes, password resets, welcome emails, and system alerts). Store your API key securely in .env and use dynamic templates for consistent branding.

name: Gemini Notebook
description: Gemini-powered research workspace for synthesizing project documentation, technical articles, and domain subjects with source-grounded citations.
howToUse: Create a dedicated notebook when starting a new project and upload official docs, specs, papers, or reference URLs. Ask targeted questions to understand unfamiliar topics, compare architecture approaches, and generate structured study guides or project briefs grounded in your sources.
